## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Automated textual analysis via DharmaNexus reveals widespread formulaic and textual reuse across the Pali corpus, identifying 66 matching passages distributed over 25 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Substantial segments of the verses are preserved and cited within the commentary on the *Theragāthā*, namely the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (first part, 13 matches, notably segments §1.1–5.1, as well as additional matches in the second part) [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Therāpadāna* itself, the text shares extensive parallel phrasing with other poems, showing its closest verse alignments with the *Saḷalamaṇḍapiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 400, segments §1.1–6.3), the *Uttarattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 558), and the *Candanamāliyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 487) [DharmaNexus]. Across non-Pali traditions, DharmaNexus records minor machine-calculated alignments with the Tibetan *Puṇyabala-avadāna* (D0347), though these reflect computational similarities rather than established historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
